problem: The shape makes asternIceOperationIntent mandatory for every ship and requires an explicit false value when the conditional requirement does not apply, although the requirement only constrains ships intended to operate astern in ice regions and does not require recording a negative applicability value.
required_change: Model the requirement as an implication: when asternIceOperationIntent is true, require the aft-section design basis; do not require asternIceOperationIntent to exist or be false when the condition is absent.
regression_guard: Preserve conditional applicability without introducing mandatory data for ships to which the requirement does not apply.

problem: The applicable branch additionally requires hullAreaRequirementSet to exist with the specified string, but the requirement mandates only that the aft section be designed using the Bow and Bow Intermediate hull area requirements; it does not impose a separate hullAreaRequirementSet field.
required_change: Remove the mandatory hullAreaRequirementSet property constraint unless that field is independently declared as an obligatory semantic encoding of the requirement.
regression_guard: Require only the mandated aft-section design-basis result when astern ice operation intent is true.
